reading.action: Bind the welded chain to ember (mesh it with Burning Anger, augment its reservoir), then meditate, channeling focus into the maul to fill both it and himself.

bind.quality: SUCCEEDS but CRUDE (low roll) — same-pole sets+holds, no bleed; wasteful/costly

reading.result: PART 1 BIND (1d20 seed 591034882 -> 2; WILL 20 + intent 4 + skill 1 + bias 2 vs DC 14 = score 29, margin 15 = SUCCEEDS, CRUDE quality). Same-pole ember-into-iron sets and HOLDS even crude (no bleed); low roll = wasteful essence + inelegant join, costs more focus + draws the low core lower. Reservoir +1 smallest notch of CAPACITY (thin chain mass), NOT power (atk stays 10); the new capacity arrives EMPTY (bigger tank, harder to fill). NO skill/affinity tick (routine + low roll / expenditure). PART 2A REST: CLEAN — his own disciplined meditation behind the line, refusing the haven's offered comfort, is legit (not the haven's barred 'rest'); armed-bound stays dormant (he didn't cross the line / anchor to the haven's warmth). The pull works harder while still+open: TAX (recovery capped near-full, not 100) + TELL (reads the haven's hunger leaning in; intel, no ment-roll). PART 2B CONSERVATION: 'both full' NOT available (affinity moves heat, doesn't create; no fuel; haven gold heatless). He channels his OWN focus into the maul (rob-Peter, his stated method) -> near-full self + MODERATE maul, not both-brimming. Did NOT siphon the winding-drum (its residual heat = the one real external source, perceived/primed by t73, left available — not assumed). POOLS: hp 124/124 (unchanged); stamina 24 -> 68 (natural rest, pull-taxed; untouched by expenditures so rebounds strong); focus 85 -> 96 (+11 net only — crude bind cost + maul-transfer + pull-tax eat the gain; the asymmetry vs stamina is the conservation lesson visible). Maul LOW -> MODERATE; reservoir a notch deeper (mostly empty). NO XP (flat leveling). Ends on the situation; no assume of his next move. NO Tower reset.
